summary: Preserved the candidate's speculative-stage classification and asynchronous default export, removed the background collective-ordering race, made the regression portable, and made SGLANG_PROFILE_V2 trace export asynchronous as well.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b0e05ade0242/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_profiler_manager_stage_stop.py::TestProfilerManagerStageStop::test_trace_export_does_not_block_stop (exact candidate, private parent absent)
tests.what_was_measured: The candidate regression was not portable and failed with FileNotFoundError for its campaign-private /tmp parent.
Two Gloo ranks entered background barrier and scheduler all_reduce in different orders and hung.
5 passed, 10 skipped, and 2 speculative-mode subtests passed; both default and v2 mocked exports return without blocking and issue no barrier.
The former two-rank collective-ordering counterexample completed; both ranks observed all_reduce value 3.0.
Actual gfx950 execution through the changed v2 profiler produced a 41,705-byte trace and max absolute matrix-multiply error 3.0517578125e-05 versus CPU.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 executed the retained v2 profiler fixture; this was single-rank and was not the reported model workload.

remaining_limitations: No B200 x8 allocation, GLM-5.2 weights, or reported TP8/MTP serving workload was available, so the 25-second duration and TTFT impact were not reproduced end to end.
Only one gfx950 GPU was available; the distributed regression used two CPU Gloo processes and does not claim multi-rank GPU trace validation.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
